description: Fail-closed regression gate for Krita as a peer frontend of the existing FA3 AI image-editing profile with replaceable generative, local-vision and MCP adapters under existing FA3 authorities.

checks.name: Shared profile is reused
checks.expected: FA3-AI-IMAGE-EDITING-001 remains a subprofile of FA3-IMGGEN-001 and includes both GIMP and Krita

checks.name: Krita AI Diffusion provider is bounded
checks.expected: Krita AI Diffusion is optional, replaceable and cannot acquire workflow/model/resource/policy/provenance authority

checks.name: Vision model admission is mandatory
checks.expected: Krita Vision Tools may execute only admitted model assets in FA3-governed mode

checks.name: MCP stays beneath central gateway
checks.expected: Krita MCP control requires FA3-AUTH-MCP-GATEWAY-001 in FA3-governed mode

checks.name: MCP transport is bounded
checks.expected: Krita MCP bridge is authenticated loopback-only with typed operations and GUI-main-thread mutation dispatch

checks.name: Hardware is dynamic
checks.expected: No canonical GPU SKU, device index, device count or fixed VRAM binding

checks.name: Backend is replaceable
checks.expected: Provider replacement does not change canonical edit intent

checks.name: Supply-chain admission applies
checks.expected: Plugin, dependencies, workflows, custom nodes and model artifacts remain admission/inventory/hash governed

checks.name: License boundary is preserved
checks.expected: GPL code is not copied into permissive FA3 components without an explicit license-policy change

checks.name: Document mutation is fail-safe
checks.expected: Default result placement is nondestructive and provider failures do not mutate source documents

checks.name: Upstream references are immutable
checks.expected: All evaluated upstream sources carry 40-character revisions, observation date and license

checks.name: Runtime evidence is not overclaimed
checks.expected: Current-host production remains NOT_CLAIMED until fresh executable evidence exists

pass_condition: All KIE-01 through KIE-15 checks pass and no P0 invariant in canonical/krita-ai-image-editing-enforcement.json is violated.
promotion_rule: Static/reference CI PASS proves canonical conformance only; current-host Krita/ComfyUI/MCP runtime promotion requires separate fresh production evidence.
